facts.text: The Missouri Land Grant covers tuition and mandatory fees for incoming first-year Missouri residents who are Pell Grant-eligible and enroll full-time. It's awarded automatically; file the FAFSA by the priority deadline.

sources.title: Mizzou Financial Aid, Missouri Land Grant

facts.text: The Missouri Land Grant covers all tuition for eligible incoming first-time freshmen and is awarded automatically.

sources.title: Missouri Land Grant - Student Financial Aid
